title: The World's Most Common Wild Bird Flies in Flocks of 2 Million

scenes.text: This bird outnumbers every other wild bird.
It's the red-billed quelea, sparrow-sized, from Africa.
Estimates run from one to two billion birds.
Flocks can reach two million or more.
One colony can cover hundreds of acres.
A bird that small, and billions strong.

description:
The red-billed quelea is thought to be the most abundant wild bird on Earth, with an estimated one to two billion birds.
Flocks can reach two million or more, and a single colony can cover hundreds of acres.
Have you ever seen a flock this big?
first_comment: What is the biggest flock you have ever seen?
